name: Kurama Koharu

[url=/c49563]Masaomi's[/url] cousin who is one year younger than him. Though she's normally kind, when it comes to her brother, [url=/c57807]Rentarou[/url], she turns rather strict. Works at a nearby Japanese sweets shop.
